assumptions: 3D static design pose: the chain is fully extended along +X and gravity is -Z. Pitch axes are +Y, wrist roll and EE axes are +X, and wrist yaw/base yaw axes are +Z. All stated coaxial assemblies have zero lateral COM offset. RMD motor masses and torque ratings are user inputs. MX-106R/T limits use a provisional 4.2 Nm design value (50% of 8.4 Nm stall), not a verified continuous rating. MG996R bare mass is assumed to be 0.055 kg; horn, cable, fasteners, and bracket require measured installed mass. The ee segment already includes the complete fixed EE assembly (0.400 kg), so tool_mass_kg is zero; if a separate interchangeable tool-tip mass is added, only that mass belongs in tool_mass_kg. Dynamics, acceleration, collision, stiffness, and impact are excluded.

base_joint.name: base_yaw
base_joint.limit_note: User assumption: 50% of 9.9 Nm stall; not a verified continuous rating.

tool_changer.note: Tool-change actuator mounted coaxially with the MX-106T EE motor. The assumed 0.055 kg is added separately at the EE-axis origin; horn, cable, fasteners, and bracket are not included.

segments.name: shoulder
segments.motor_spec_note: User supplied motor-only mass and rated output torque; revision and continuous operating conditions unverified. Add bracket mass separately.

segments.name: elbow
segments.motor_spec_note: User supplied motor-only mass and rated output torque; revision and continuous operating conditions unverified. Add bracket mass separately.

segments.name: wrist

bearing_support.fastener: M8 partially threaded bolt; smooth shank through the inner race
bearing_support.race_arrangement: inner race fixed to the M8 axle; outer race pressed into and rotating with the wrist link

opposite_bearing.rating_note: Representative 608 rating; verify the selected manufacturer's datasheet before release.

bearing_support.note: Only wrist pitch receives an added opposite-side bearing. Shoulder and elbow remain single-sided hinge supports. The load plane is assumed centered between supports.

segments.motor_spec_note: User supplied motor-only mass and rated output torque; revision and continuous operating conditions unverified. Add bracket mass separately.

segments.name: wrist_roll

bearing_support.fastener: M3 bolts used as fixed inner axles
bearing_support.race_arrangement: 623ZZ inner races fixed; outer races rotate with the roll assembly

opposite_bearing.rating_note: Representative 623 rating; verify the selected manufacturer's datasheet.

bearing_support.note: The 40 mm bearing-center span is an explicit design assumption based on motor thickness and must be replaced by the measured center distance.

segments.motor_spec_note: Wrist roll is coaxial with the downstream chain. With zero lateral COM offset, gravity creates zero roll-axis motor torque but a transverse bending moment reacted by the two 623ZZ supports.

segments.name: wrist_yaw
segments.motor_spec_note: Wrist-yaw MX-106T. The 3D screen evaluates the design pose and the worst gravity torque reached while the upstream roll axis sweeps. Dynamic inertia, docking wrench, backlash, and bracket stiffness remain separate.

segments.name: ee
segments.motor_spec_note: Independent end-effector gripper-pinion MX-106T #2. Its pinion axis drives the gripper and ballpoint-style lock/unlock mechanism; it is not an arm pose joint. Fixed design point: 0.160 m, 0.400 kg total (0.300 kg motor-plus-bracket assembly plus 0.100 kg structure). Motor alone is 0.153 kg. Assembly mass needs measurement.

additional_loads.name: tool_changer_motor
additional_loads.mass_note: Assumed bare-servo mass. Replace with measured installed mass including horn, cable, fasteners, and bracket.

base_motor_reference.note: User assumption: stall times 0.5, NOT manufacturer rated torque. The same provisional limit is consumed by base_joint for the 3D static screen.
